summary: Strata at Mission Bay is a roughly 192-193 unit apartment building at 555 Mission Rock St; SocketSite reported in January 2009 that its units were scheduled to come online that March, and DataSF Assessor records give 2009 as the building's construction-completion year.

milestones.text: Strata at Mission Bay's rental units come online, per contemporaneous real estate press; DataSF Assessor records also give 2009 as this building's construction-completion year

open_questions: DataSF Assessor lists 193 units for this parcel versus the 192 reported by SocketSite and repeated across apartment-listing sites; the one-unit gap (possibly a manager's unit or a later modification) is not resolved.
